fato_historico: 1926: The international Convention to Suppress the Slave Trade and Slavery is first signed.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to reflect on liberation, Taurus. Just as a historic global movement once sought to break chains and restore human dignity, you may feel inspired to release outdated habits that hold your spirit captive. It is a good time to clear your path and embrace a more grounded, authentic version of yourself in this beautiful world.
frase_do_dia: True freedom blooms when you nurture your own soul with love and kindness.
significado_numero: A powerful cycle representing partnership and the pursuit of universal harmony.
conselho: Consider letting go of heavy burdens and step lightly into your radiant future.
